name: tapestry
description: Long-term memory for Claude Code: facts that come to mind when they matter. Draws the lasting facts from each conversation, recalls what bears on each prompt with honest match and belief labels, and keeps each project's memories in their own topic.

judge.title: Which model draws facts and checks conflicts
judge.description: In the background, after a session ends, a model draws the lasting facts a conversation taught, and checks whether memories that sit close together contradict each other. auto: nothing is sent unless a Jev key is set below, and then only for conflicts. claude: each ended conversation, with the memories nearest it, and close pairs of memories are sent to Claude (Haiku) through the Claude Code login you already use. jev: close pairs of memories are sent to TypeSafe's Jev model through the Vercel AI Gateway with the key below, with no zero-data-retention flag; Jev can't draw facts, so conversations wait. none: nothing leaves your machine, and only what the agent notes is remembered.

jev_key.title: Vercel AI Gateway key for Jev
jev_key.description: Only used if Jev is the judge, or if the choice above is auto. Needs paid gateway credits.
